notes: Theorem 6 restricts the input type S to positive-arity relations; the auxiliary type T may include functions before graph conversion.

role: class of nonempty finite structures of the specified type
notes: Empty vocabulary is allowed; empty universe is not.

role: finite reduct class admitting the specified same-universe expansion
notes: The second-order existential prefix binds all auxiliary relation and function symbols.

role: input relation its positive arity and characteristic word
notes: Both type order and tuple lexicographic order are fixed by the encoding.

role: original encoding and encoded language of a finite-structure class
notes: Binary size prefix and relation-table words; this is not an arbitrary or succinct encoding.

role: universe cardinality and encoded word length
notes: They are polynomially related only when the fixed positive-arity input type is nonempty.

role: original polynomial and single-exponential nondeterministic time classes
notes: NP_1 uses some time bound 2 raised to k times input length; it is not NP on the original binary numerical input.

role: auxiliary function graph and recursive term-value formula
notes: Graph coding enforces totality and single-valuedness; constants use unary singleton graphs.

role: pair relation and fixed-point-free involution witness
notes: F is a symmetric irreflexive total single-valued relation; f is its corresponding unary function.

role: existentially chosen strict linear order and its endpoints
notes: This order is an auxiliary witness and is not required in the input.

role: source cyclic successor function of the auxiliary order
notes: Typed function role distinct from source S denoting the fixed similarity type; last element maps to first.

role: source cyclic lexicographic successor relation on k-tuples
notes: Its final-to-initial pair is excluded for time transitions and guarded against at tape boundaries.

role: first and last tuple addresses and tuple-address count
notes: N equals n raised to the fixed tableau exponent k; slack separates the accepted run from the last address.

role: nonwrapping consecutive-time predicate
notes: Abbreviates tuple successor and the exclusion of the final time.

role: fixed machine state set tape alphabet and finite transition table
notes: Machine moves select one whole common transition for all tapes.

role: source state function tape-symbol function and unique-head relation
notes: Arity k for q and 2k for the tape and head symbols; state and alphabet range constraints are explicit.

role: successor-term codes of a state or tape symbol
notes: Code lists are individually injective but may overlap across their different typed roles.

role: source tape-symbol codes for zero one and blank
notes: These stand for the first three auxiliary order elements rather than arithmetic constants in the input structure.

role: initial accepting and rejecting state codes
notes: Final configurations are frozen through the remaining time rows.

role: source binary-digit function and explicit reconstruction carry condition
notes: y runs from least significant bit upward; C says all lower positions are one.

role: first-order formula for one complete allowed machine move
notes: State update writes unchanged cells and both head-boundary guards are included.

role: finite exceptional-size disjunction and complete finite relational diagram
notes: These supply the source's finite-modification step on the original same universe.

role: finite variable-slot bound used for pure-set equality-pattern invariance
notes: A scalar variable bound distinct from indexed source tape functions v_i; includes tuple binders parameters and all alpha-renamed individual variables.
